diagnosis.originalFailure: Closed-device Mix_HaltMusic replaced the existing SDL error; close_music retained music_spec so a later Mix_Init allocated decoder lists without an open device.
diagnosis.separateCauses: Mix_QuerySpec guard alone corrected the diagnostic but left two allocations. Forwarding real SDL memory functions traced exactly two realloc(NULL,4) calls underneath Mix_Init during request startup.

fixtureCorrections: Mix_OpenAudio permits frequency/channel negotiation; exact-format verification uses Mix_OpenAudioDevice with allowedChanges=0.
TTF_FontFaceIsFixedWidth returns a native nonzero flag (4 for this font), not a normalized 1.
